ctx.x: was taken from the studio band and they copied the way we accompanied Evelyn from the recordings that were done during the three broadcasts we did and Evelyn did ten more broadcasts without us.

One afternoon, I had a dispute with one of the co-owners of the building where my brother and I had an apartment and it finished with him on the floor where I had knocked him. He had me arrested and I heard the jail door clang shut behind me again. I didn't know anyone to go my bail, so I missed a night at the Blue Angel. Russell Gillion was a fellow I could always depend on to replace me, as he had done a few times at the Cafe Society Uptown, but I didn't have his phone number with me when I was locked up. The…

After quite a few months at the Angel, we began to feel that we were liked well enough and popular enough to ask for a raise in salary and we did ask for it. We got exactly the same answer from Jacoby that Barney Josephson had given us when we asked him for a raise. Jacoby said: You boys deserve a raise and we thought the matter was settled. We did not speak about the amount because we thought that it would be at least five dollars each.
